strings.project: Preparing for a mental health professional appointment
strings.pilot: Prototype · LV v16 reference · not clinically validated
strings.intro: Take your time. This free questionnaire helps you prepare for an appointment. Answer what you feel comfortable sharing; you can skip anything. It does not provide a diagnosis.
strings.reviewNote: English and Russian text in this prototype remains unreviewed draft translation.
strings.privacy: Privacy: this file works entirely offline, with no analytics or automatic transmission. Responses exist only in this session and files you choose to download.
strings.selectIntro: Choose any topics you want. Every section and question is optional. Only part of the full questionnaire is available in this pilot.
strings.skipSection: Skip remaining questions in this section
strings.credits: Space for recognized contributors, with their consent.
strings.help: If someone's safety is in immediate danger, call 112 or seek emergency assistance.
strings.saveWarning: Selection is not saved until you press Save & Next.
strings.optionalText: Optional. You may leave this blank.
strings.copyFailure: Clipboard unavailable; select and copy the text below.
strings.restoreError: Cannot load this file. Check its format and version.
strings.saved10: Another 10 answers saved; cumulative recovery file downloaded.
strings.newConfirm: Start a new questionnaire? Unsaved/exported answers will be lost.
strings.skipConfirm: Skip the rest of this section?
strings.restConfirm: Finish now and open the incomplete results?
strings.doctorDisclaimer: Self-reported information; not a diagnosis or automated risk classification.
strings.noneFlagged: You decide which answers to share or discuss.
strings.noAuto: One choice: tap to save and continue. Several choices or text: use Save & Next. Download a recovery file to keep your progress.
strings.footer: Prototype for testing only; not for clinical diagnosis.
strings.noSection: No topics selected. You can choose topics or view your answers.
strings.warningSensitive: If an answer concerns immediate safety, seek help now. Completing this questionnaire is not a substitute for emergency support.
strings.safetyPending: You may answer or skip any question.
strings.guideIntro: Choose the topics you want to discuss.
strings.replaceSession: Replace the current session with this recovery file?
strings.visitSummary: Person and reason for the visit

strings.omissionNote: Omitted questions are not negative answers.
strings.supportBody: Even if it feels as though nobody understands, there are people who want to listen. Consider calling 116 123. It is free and available 24 hours a day, including at night, in Latvian, English and Russian. You do not need a prepared speech. You can simply say: “I’m having a hard time.”
strings.emergencyBody: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112 for emergency assistance. The support line does not replace emergency help.
strings.guideBody: Open the downloaded HTML file in your browser; a file preview cannot run it. No separate instructions file is needed. Your answers stay in this session unless you download or share them. Keep a recovery file before closing. Copy for Read the text before sharing. You choose what to discuss with a clinician.
strings.notesBody: v0.2 (2026-11-06) — optional topics, personal details at the end, single-tap answers, fixed Skip, supportive messages, a compact clinician report. Earlier pilot v0.1 — 60 questions in three languages, manual save, recovery files and source-fidelity tests. This is a test version, not a public release.
strings.coverageNote: Counts cover applicable pilot questions. Answers hidden by a changed condition are retained in recovery files but excluded here.
strings.autoHint: Tap one answer to save and continue.
